LegalRath Daily Legal Brief - From the Supreme Court pulling up States on police gear at protests, to Nandan Nilekani chairing a panel on fixing India's exam leak crisis, to a Delhi HC ruling that could shape how Indian courts treat AI training data under copyright law.

Six developments, six minutes, everything you need to stay exam-ready and courtroom-aware.

🔹 SC: peaceful protest ≠ grounds for lathi-charge
 🔹 Centre's high-level committee on exam reforms (NEET leak fallout)
 🔹 Karnataka HC on a Muslim father's maintenance duty under BNSS
 🔹 Allahabad HC enhances maintenance for a concealed-marriage second wife
 🔹 Delhi HC: OpenAI's use of ANI's content for training isn't infringement — for now
